activity_statements.statement: manufactures flat-rolled steel products (hot-rolled, cold-rolled, coated) using both integrated blast furnace/BOF steelmaking and electric arc furnace (EAF) mini mill technology
produces VerdeX steel with up to 90% recycled steel content, achieving up to 75% lower carbon footprint versus traditional steelmaking methods, via Big River Steel EAF operations in Arkansas
supplies steel to customers in automotive, construction, appliance, energy, electrical, industrial, mining, and packaging markets
operates a Research and Technology Center developing next-generation steel products including advanced high-strength steels (AHSS) for automotive lightweighting
operates US Steel Kosice (Slovakia) as its European integrated steelmaking facility alongside US operations in Indiana, Minnesota, Pennsylvania, and Arkansas
has operated as a steel manufacturer for 120+ years, supplying structural steel for bridges, buildings, and critical infrastructure

segments.name: North American Flat-Rolled (including Big River Steel)

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Manufacturing' is generic; U.S. Steel is specifically a steel manufacturer undergoing a technology transition from blast-furnace integrated steelmaking toward EAF mini-mill production — making it an active participant in steel decarbonization, not a static heavy industry company the name implies.
extraction_notes: Good content from about-us/overview. Segment weights are directional approximations. Big River Steel is now integrated into U.S. Steel rather than a separately reported segment in all filings.
